**Candidate invoices:**

1. INV-00203: 6,000,000 paise, issued 2026-09-10, due 2026-09-25
2. INV-00204: 6,000,000 paise, issued 2026-09-13, due 2026-09-28

Both match the amount, and both are for the correct customer (CUST00192 = Sai Mishra). The payment was captured on 2026-09-16, which is after both invoice issue dates and before both due dates, which is reasonable.

However, I have two candidates with identical amounts for the same customer. Since the payment amount (6,000,000 paise) matches exactly one invoice at a time, I need to determine which one was actually paid.

Looking at the timeline:
- INV-00203 issued 2026-09-10 (due 2026-09-25)
- Payment captured 2026-09-16
- INV-00204 issued 2026-09-13 (due 2026-09-28)

The payment on 2026-09-16 is most naturally matched to INV-00203, which was issued first and had the earliest due date. This represents a straightforward single-invoice payment scenario.

input.rationale: Payment of ₹60,000 (6,000,000 paise) captured on 2026-09-16 for customer CUST00192 (Sai Mishra) matches invoice INV-00203 issued on 2026-09-10. While INV-00204 is also available for the same customer with the same amount, the chronological order and earlier due date of INV-00203 make it the more natural match.
